steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: 'Within Her Eyes' was choreographed by James Cousins and premiered in 2012 | Key Fact: The work is a duet for one male and one female dancer exploring love, loss and memory | Key Fact: The choreographic intention is to show the emotional weight of a relationship — the woman is never placed on the floor, always supported | Key Fact: The stimulus was the concept of carrying emotional and physical weight within a relationship

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from within her eyes — james cousins, and one past-paper question.
